recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit. If a code-plus-reference composite search is desired later, handle it under a separate Jira with a distinct parameter design so the FHIR-28291 reference search remains usable.
issue_request: FHIR-28291 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for FHIR-core Group. It asked that searching /Group?characteristic-reference=Organization/123 return Groups with any characteristic whose value references Organization/123.
initial_application: Commit 7b5847c83c5ea46b8982c2cb4e974103c8f69fcf originally applied the issue by adding Group-characteristic-reference as a reference search parameter over Group.characteristic.value; the R5 history artifact still records it as type reference with documentation 'An entity referenced in a characteristic.'
additional_context: Group is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml is current build input. Later history changed the parameter to composite under an unrelated FHIR-48885-labeled commit, and FHIR-40341 later fixed only a malformed composite component expression without superseding FHIR-28291's plain reference query shape.
reconciliation: Changed source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml so Group-characteristic-reference is again type reference with expression (Group.characteristic.value.ofType(Reference)) and no composite components.
source_changes: source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml: restored Group-characteristic-reference from composite to reference, with the original reference-oriented description and valueReference FHIRPath expression.
